title: Layout
summary: The window widths at which the layout changes.

stories.want: the app to use the width
stories.soThat: I compare side by side instead of scrolling

requirements.text: The layout changes at these widths and no others: `layout.sidebar-from`, `layout.spec-split-from`, `layout.diff-split-from` and `layout.sidebar-names-from`.
Below `layout.sidebar-from` everything is one column, with the main sections in a bar at the bottom.

values.description: The main sections move to a sidebar, and settings shows its menu beside the page.
A changed text of a spec shows the old beside the new.
A file's diff shows the old beside the new.
The sidebar shows names next to its icons.
The desktop window, the first time it opens.
